verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.20
2. Walking
A Meal Assigner

verses.pali: “Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhattuddesako yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: “Mendicants, a meal assigner who has four qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.
What four?

verses.pali: Chandāgatiṁ gacchati, dosāgatiṁ gacchati, mohāgatiṁ gacchati, bhayāgatiṁ gacchati—
verses.english: They make decisions prejudiced by favoritism, hostility, stupidity, and cowardice.

verses.pali: imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhattuddesako yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: A meal assigner who has these four qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhattuddesako yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge.
verses.english: A meal designator who has four qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.
What four?

verses.pali: Na chandāgatiṁ gacchati, na dosāgatiṁ gacchati, na mohāgatiṁ gacchati, na bhayāgatiṁ gacchati—
verses.english: They make decisions unprejudiced by favoritism, hostility, stupidity, and cowardice.

verses.pali: imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhattuddesako yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ saggeti.
verses.english: A meal assigner who has these four qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.
All those people with unbridled sensuality,
unprincipled, with no respect for principle,

verses.pali: Chandā dosā mohā ca bhayā gāmino,
verses.english: led astray <j>by favoritism, hostility, stupidity, or cowardice,
are called ‘an assembly of the dregs’:
that’s what was said by the ascetic who knows.
And so those praiseworthy true persons,

verses.pali: Dhamme ṭhitā ye na karonti pāpakaṁ,
verses.english: standing on principle, doing nothing wrong,

verses.pali: Na chandā na dosā na mohā na bhayā ca gāmino;
verses.english: not led astray <j>by favoritism, hostility, stupidity, or cowardice,
are called ‘an assembly of the cream’:
that’s what was said by the ascetic who knows.”
